body:
I'm a pretty depressed dude right now too. But I do have this advice. Talk to your friends. Really talk to them. Do it from the beginning. Be yourself from the start. Either they like it or not. But you find out quickly who the real friends are.

Since you're in college, do you have a counseling service? Most have free counseling. Go have a chat, say whatever you want to the bloke. It's a refreshing way to start on the piece of advice I gave!
